body.purpose: Simplified Chinese UI and status text.

language-route.purpose: Language names on the bookmarked sheet.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Button colors and settings chevron rotation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled action for translating or confirming a send.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #90877e); border-radius: var(--control, 10px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #b14520); color: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #faeee2); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #e5dfd7); background: var(--panel, #f8f6f2); color: var(--muted, #6a635b); cursor: default; } .ds-primary:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent, #b14520); border-color: var(--accent, #b14520); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #903514); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #903514); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-active, #73290f); border-color: var(--accent-active, #73290f); } .ds-primary { transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action for canceling confirmation or managing the key.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #90877e); border-radius: var(--control, 10px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #b14520); color: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #faeee2); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #e5dfd7); background: var(--panel, #f8f6f2); color: var(--muted, #6a635b); cursor: default; } .ds-secondary { transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Restore Button
components.description: Softly filled secondary action that restores the original page text.
components.css: .ds-restore { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--control, 10px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--panel, #f8f6f2); color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-restore:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #faeee2); color: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-restore:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-restore:disabled { background: var(--panel, #f8f6f2); color: var(--muted, #6a635b); cursor: default; } .ds-restore { transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-restore { transition: none; } }

components.name: API Key Field
components.description: Labeled password field for a user-supplied DeepSeek API Key.
components.html: <label class="ds-key">DeepSeek API Key<input type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="粘贴你的 API Key"></label>
components.css: .ds-key { display: block; color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 650 12px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key input { display: block; margin-top: 4px; min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #90877e); border-radius: var(--control, 10px); color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); caret-color: var(--accent, #b14520); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #6a635b); opacity: 1; } .ds-key input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bookmarked Language Sheet
components.description: Read-only language route and current page status beneath a notched bookmark.
components.html:
英文译为简体中文

打开网页后即可手动翻译。
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; padding: 15px 16px 13px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--accent-soft, #faeee2); } .ds-sheet::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 17px; width: 10px; height: 17px; background: #cf8766; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 50% 78%, 0 100%); } .ds-route { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; padding-right: 18px; } .ds-route { font: 600 21px/1.45 "Songti SC", STSong, "Noto Serif CJK SC", serif; } .ds-route > span:not(.ds-direction) { white-space: nowrap; } .ds-direction { position: relative; width: 21px; height: 1px; background: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-direction::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -3px; right: 0; width: 7px; height: 7px; border: solid var(--accent, #b14520); border-width: 1px 1px 0 0; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #6a635b); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-sheet { color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 14px/1.55 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-route { margin: 0; } .ds-status { margin-bottom: 0; } @media (max-width: 300px) { .ds-route { gap: 8px; font-size: 18px; } }

components.name: Send Confirmation
components.description: Inline consent for sending the current page text to DeepSeek.
components.html:
确认发送正文

将当前页面可翻译的正文发送至 DeepSeek。该确认仅对当前页面有效。
components.css: .ds-consent { padding: 12px 0 0; color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-consent h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-consent p { margin: 4px 0 12px; } .ds-consent-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-consent-actions button { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #90877e); border-radius: var(--control, 10px); padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 650 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-consent-actions button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #b14520); color: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-consent-actions button:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-soft, #faeee2); } .ds-consent-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-consent-actions button:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #e5dfd7); background: var(--panel, #f8f6f2); color: var(--muted, #6a635b); cursor: default; } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm { background: var(--accent, #b14520); border-color: var(--accent, #b14520); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #903514); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #903514); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-active, #73290f); border-color: var(--accent-active, #73290f); } .ds-consent-actions button { transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-consent-actions button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Settings Disclosure
components.description: Shared disclosure for DeepSeek API Key and GitHub interface translation.
components.html:
设置已配置

Key 保存在此浏览器。连接测试使用固定短文本。
components.css: .ds-settings { padding: 0 var(--inset, 16px); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e5dfd7); } .ds-settings { background: var(--panel, #f8f6f2); } .ds-settings-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; color: var(--muted, #6a635b); } .ds-settings summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings summary:hover { color: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-settings summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-settings summary::after { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: none; border: solid currentColor; border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform: rotate(-45deg); margin-inline: 3px 2px; transition: transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-settings[open] summary::after { transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-key-state { margin-inline-start: auto; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; color: var(--muted, #6a635b); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-key-state[data-configured] { color: var(--success, #176445); } .ds-key-state[data-configured]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: 2px; background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-settings { color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 14px/1.55 "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-settings summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-settings p { color: var(--muted, #6a635b); font-size: 12px; margin: 6px 0 10px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-settings summary::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: GitHub Switch
components.description: Independent local interface translation setting for GitHub.
components.css: .ds-github { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; padding: 12px 0 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e5dfd7); color: var(--ink, #2d2b28); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-github strong { display: block; font-weight: 650; } .ds-github small { display: block; color: var(--muted, #6a635b); font-size: 12px; } .ds-github input { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 44px; height: 26px; margin: 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #90877e); border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-github input::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 3px auto 3px 3px; width: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted, #6a635b); transition: transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-github input:checked { background: var(--accent, #b14520); border-color: var(--accent, #b14520); } .ds-github input:checked::before { transform: translateX(18px); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-github input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-active, #73290f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-github input:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-github input::before { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: Yoread borrows the open-book mark, serif lettering and bookmark of a printed book for a short browser task. The language route takes the largest type in the workspace. A reader can check the current page’s status directly beneath it and reach the translation action in the next row.
keyCharacteristics: The masthead pairs Yoread with its translation provider.
One warm paper sheet groups the language route, status and progress.
The bottom disclosure keeps configuration within reach.
